noble-gas-configuration.def: An electron configuration with the same arrangement as a noble gas, such as Na⁺ and F⁻ (both like neon). Particles with the same number of electrons are isoelectronic.

ionic-compound.def: A compound made of cations and anions held together by their opposite charges, in the ratio that makes it neutral; its simplest unit (such as one NaCl) is a formula unit.
